title: Qin2023 action observation ECoG: re-referenced region-of-interest electrocorticography during observation of predictable and unpredictable action movies
description: Re-referenced region-of-interest electrocorticography (ECoG) recorded continuously at 1000 Hz from 10 epilepsy patients (8.70 h in total) while they watched movies of sequential actions that were either predictable or unpredictable. The derivative dataset repackages the authors' OSF release of FieldTrip structures into BIDS iEEG format, with camera-change events, ACPC and MNI electrode positions, and the stimulus movies and annotations. It supports investigation of predictive coding and information flow during action observation.
methods_description: Continuous ECoG from epilepsy patients watching movies of sequential actions was re-referenced by the original authors and restricted to region-of-interest channels. FieldTrip data were converted to BrainVision float32 format. Events are camera-change triggers in the movies, and electrode positions are given in ACPC and MNI coordinates.
